tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'go ba'i lha lnga gsol mchod 'jig rten bde 'byung bzhugs so// oṃ ā yu shrī puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ 'dir 'go ba'i lha lnga gsol mchod rgya gar shes bsangs dang sbrel nas gtong tshul ni/ snod gtsang mar mo zhang ma lha rnams la sman le 'brang rgyas lug gzugs/ srog lha skyes lhar ra gzugs dmar po/ pho lha pha mes dbang lhar lug gzugs/ yul lha mkhar lhar g.yag dkar gzugs/ dgra lha rig 'dzin ban bon chos srung la bshos ba 'brang skyes/ 'chang bu rnams bshams drung gzhung nas bshad pa'i mchod rdzas ci 'byor bshams shing chang gi sbyangs spos gtsang mas bdug sngags drug phyag drug skyabs sems bdag bskyed skad cig dran rdzogs rnams ni bsangs kyi 'go na yod pas logs su bya mi dgos/ pho lha gnyan po thams cad bsangs/ kyai/ bsangs so zhes pa'i rjes su/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni rnga brdung bzhin pas 'di skad du/ kyai/ rang nyid rta mchog dpal gyi mdun/ /paṃ pad a zla'i dkyil 'khor lnga'i/ /dang por dzñā las mo lha dkar/ /yid 'ong zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /g.yas pa mda' dar g.yon me long / /dar sngon ber gsol rin chen thod/ /sna tshogs rgyan can yu mo yi/ /shwa bar chibs shing sprul pa ni/ /ma dang sru mo'i rnam par ston/ /gzhan yang zhang lha skyes dar ma/ /sprul pa bya chen go bo dang / /zhang blon mang po'i rnam par ston/ /mo lha sman btsun mdzes ma'i tshogs/ /sprul pa na chung sha bar ston/ /gnyis par na las srog lha dkar/ /dar ma'i skyes gzugs zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis g.yas mdung g.yon zhags pa/ /khrab rmog stag ral gzig shubs can/ /sag r+b+pa rta nag sga srab chibs/ /sprul pa mi rta dkar por ston/ /gzhan yang lhan gcig skyes lha ni/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan spras shing / /sprul pa mi dkar rnam par ston/ /gsum par ā las pho lha dkar/ /lang tsho dar babs zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis g.yas g.yon nor bu dang /

/rin po ches gang gzhong pa bsnams/ /ral thod dar brtsegs rtse ber sngo/ /rin chen rgyan dang sag r+b+pa gsol/ /rta mchog ngang dkar sga srab can/ /chibs shing sprul pa pha spun dang / /'khor gsum can gyi skyes par ston/ /gzhan yang rang rang pha mes lha/ /dbang lha sum cu'i tshogs rnams kun/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /bzhi par yu las yul lha dkar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /khrab rmog stag ral gzig shubs 'chang / /sag r+b+pa gyon cing rta dkar la/ /sga srab brgyan chibs sprul pa ni/ /mched grogs yul gtso lug khyu g.yag /dkar po du ma'i rnam par ston/ /gzhan yang rtse lha gnas srung tshogs/ /sna tshogs gos brgyan sprul pa ni/ /bya chen mang po'i rnam par ston/ /lnga par shi las dgra lha dkar/ /dar ma'i skyes pa zhi zhing 'dzum/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mdung dar/ /g.yon zhags dar dkar rtse ber gsol/ /dar gyi thod can stag ral dang / /gzig shubs sna tshogs rin chen brgyan/ /sag r+b+pa gyon cing rta mchog dkar/ /sga srab can chibs sprul pa ni/ /dge bshes mi dkar zhub can dang / /khra spyang g.yag rgod mang por ston/ /gzhan yang phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun/ /rig 'dzin lha srung chos skyong tshogs/ /slob dpon sngags pa'i rnam par ston/ /dbang lha ban bon skyong ba rnams/ /bon dang pha wang gzugs su ston/ /brgyan spras rang rang 'khor gyis bskor/ /kun gyi dpral mgrin snying ga ru/ /rdo rje gsum dngos oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /dkar dmar mthing mtshan rang nyid ni/ /lhar gsal thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /'go ba'i lha lnga la sogs pa/ /mdun bskyed 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /gnas 'dir badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ /spyan 'dren ni gter kha 'og ma las/ kyai/ dgra lha gnyan po spyan 'dren no/ /phrag gong g.yas nas gshegs su gsol/ /sprul ni dge bshes mang por sprul/ /mchod ni gshos bu gtsang mas mchod/ /de ring bdag gi grogs la spyon/

/dmag dpung bkye la dgra dpung thul/ /zhang lha pha wang spyan 'dren no/ /mchan khung g.yon nas gshegs su gsol/ /sprul ni zhang blon mang por sprul/ /mchod ni gsang lug gtsang mas mchod/ /de ring bdag gi grogs la spyon/ /'gal rkyen spongs la mthun rkyen bsgrub tu gsol/ /srog lha 'dzin po spyan 'dren no/ /snying ga'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ /sprul ni mi dkar mang por sprul/ /mchod ni ra skyes kham pa 'di yis mchod/ /de ring bdag gi grogs la spyon/ /srog gi bar chad bsrung du gsol/ /mo lha 'byung mo spyan 'dren no/ /mchan khug g.yas nas gshegs su gsol/ /sprul ni ma sru mang por sprul/ /mchod ni 'brang rgyas ldem pas mchod/ /de ring bdag gi grogs la spyon/ /zas nor char pa dbab tu gsol/ /yul lha mgon bu spyan 'dren no/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas gshegs su gsol/ /sprul ni grogs po mang por sprul/ /gsang g.yag dkar po 'di yis mchod/ /de ring bdag gi grogs la spyon/ /yid la bsam pa thams cad bsgrub tu gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ gyis gdan phul/ gsol mchod ni/ gsar bsgrigs/ 'go ba'i lha lnga 'khor bcas la/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis sku khrus gsol/ /mi gtsang dri ma dag gyur cig /sna tshogs shing sna'i dud pa yis/ /nyams grib ma lus bsangs gyur cig /g.ya' chu gangs chu gtsang ma'i chu/ /sman chab ngad ldan skyems su 'bul/ /sna tshogs me tog chun po'i thod/ /sku la mdzes pa'i brgyan du 'bul/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum shing tog 'bru/ /bza' bca' zhim mngar bshos bu 'bul/ /nyi zla nor bu 'bru mar gyi/ /mar me gsal byed sgron me sbar/ /kha dog sna tshogs za 'og gos/ /rin chen du ma'i do shal dang / /prog zhu snyan cha g.yu bur bkra/ /go mtshon dar thod mdzes brjid chas/ /stag ral gzig shubs mda' mdung gri/ /rin chen gzhong pa nor bu sogs/ /phyag mtshan rlung gi shugs ldan rta/

/sga srab mdzes pa'i chas kyis brgyan/ /shwa ba la sogs bgrod byed chibs/ /gnam la 'phur dgu sa gzhi la/ /'dzul dgu ri dwags mchongs dgu sogs/ /sna tshogs srog chags bgrang las 'das/ /rgyal srid bdun dang 'dod yon lnga/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs pa'i/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor nam mkha' bskang / /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs kyis/ /lha lnga 'khor bcas gsol zhing mchod/ /gtor ma rgyal mtshan bshos bu dang / /ja chang gser skyems btung ba'i tshogs/ /ljags kyi dbang po tshim byed pa'i/ /zhal zas skyems kyis gsol zhing mchod/ /mo lha zhang lha ma lha la/ /sman le 'brang rgyas gsang lug 'bul/ /zhang po'i mda' yi mde'u dang / /ma sru'i 'phang rnams rten du 'dzugs/ /srog lha skyes lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /ra skyes kham pas mchod pa 'bul/ /'phan dar phyug po pha spun mda'/ /dar gyi ru mtshon rten du 'dzugs/ /pho lha pha mes dbang thang lhar/ /gsang lug gtsang ma'i mchod pa 'bul/ /dar mdung nas dkar rten du 'dzugs/ /yul khang mkhar gyi rtse lha la/ /lha g.yag dkar po'i mchod pa 'bul/ /phyug btsan dar khab rten du 'dzugs/ /dgra lha rig 'dzin dbang lha dang / /ban bon chos srung tshogs rnams la/ /bshos bu gtsang ma'i mchod pa 'bul/ /dpa' g.yu phyug mdel rten du 'dzugs/ /dar tshon sna lnga dkar dmar dar/ /g.yu chung mig med gser dngul zangs/ /lcags dang byu ru man shel tshogs/ /pha shing ma shing bu shing gsum/ /byang bu mig dgu 'chang bu dang / /nas dkar rten gyis lha lnga skongs/ /bdag sogs mi nor rigs brgyud la/ /mi 'bral rtag tu bsrung skyob mdzod/ /yul lhas spyi bo'i gtsug nas srungs/ /dgra lhas khrag pa g.yas nas bsrungs/ /pho lhas mchan khung g.yas nas bsrungs/ /mo lhas mchan khung g.yon nas bsrungs/ /yul lhas snying ga'i dkyil nas bsrungs/ /rig 'dzin ban bon chos skyong gis/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun nas bsrungs/

/tshe dpal bsod nams mnga' thang bskyed/ /so so lha rgyal lo/ grwa pa mngon shes kyi gtor ma'i las bcol ni/ kyai/ lha dang mi ru ma 'bral zhig /bdud char ltar babs na/ lhas sba ltar skyobs shig gnod dgra ltar gnod na/ lhas zun ltar skyobs shig 'dres rkun ltar 'jabs na/ lhas khyi ltar zug cig lha 'og nas mi ma yar zhig dgra 'og nas god ma gtong zhig bsrung 'og tu gdon ma ldang zhig gnyen 'og tu rmas ma ldang zhig khyi 'og tu rkun ma ma 'jabs shig gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad bsrung ba 'di las ma 'da' zhig bkra shis gzhung legs pa'i rtas srungs shig lo brgya thub la ston brgya za ba'i rtas srungs shig bkra shis nad med bsam pa 'grub pa dang / /nad gdon 'byung po ma lus zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang rgyas pa dang / /bdag gi lus ngag yid la mi mthun nad gdon bsrung zhing zhi bar mdzod cig swāhā/ de nas dgra lha dpang bstod dang / kyai/ gzhan yang bsangs mchod 'bul ba ni/ byes kyi byes lha sogs so/ /'di ni gong sa rdo rje 'chang lnga pa chen po'i gsung las/ sa skya pa kun blos btus pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'go ba'i lha lnga gsol mchod 'jig rten bde 'byung / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
